nodes.label: @tsyn/cli bundled ESM binary (core bundled in)
nodes.rationale: Node refuses to strip types inside node_modules, so a build is forced and the CLI is the only public surface; typescript pinned to exact 7.0.2 because the adapter uses its unstable API.

nodes.label: CI pipeline steps
nodes.rationale: Runs test:coverage rather than a bare test so a coverage drop fails here instead of going unnoticed, and gives the network check its own step so the failure names itself — a red 'Test' says nothing about a dependency that started reaching the network.

nodes.label: npm provenance + RELEASE_PAT/NPM_TOKEN split
nodes.rationale: PAT so the version PR triggers CI (GITHUB_TOKEN pushes raise no pull_request event); registry token never handed to git; secrets asserted up front because empty org secrets resolve to empty strings.

nodes.label: No-network rule (ADR 0011)
nodes.rationale: No package may reach the network; enforced by oxlint no-restricted-imports/globals for first-party code and pnpm check:network over the production dependency closure, with a narrow ALLOWED list in scripts/no-network.ts.

nodes.label: Fidelity (typed / syntactic)
nodes.rationale: Stored with facts, never recomputed at query time, because it reports the analysis that ran rather than the machine now.

nodes.label: Remediation
nodes.rationale: Reported, never run or guessed.

nodes.label: Preflight
nodes.rationale: Type-checker diagnostics excluded as a signal: 3,100x the cost of the specifier scan and cannot tell prepared from unprepared repos.

nodes.label: Continuity (subject/snapshot matching)
nodes.rationale: Kept as a separate inferred layer, never part of SymbolId, because no existing system makes identity survive a rename.

nodes.label: Draft (tsyn?: candidate claims)
nodes.rationale: Never writes prose; endorsement (deleting the ?) is a person's act.

nodes.label: tsyn MCP server
nodes.rationale: Same operations and JSON envelopes as the CLI; no special agent implementation.

nodes.label: Honest answers principle
nodes.rationale: An answer that cannot say what it missed is worse than no answer; blind spot, truncation and scope never collapsed into a confidence score.

nodes.label: Typesynesthesia / fallow boundary
nodes.rationale: Two tools answering the same question with different algorithms is a recipe for disagreement; tsyn does structure, fallow does hygiene/health.

nodes.label: Exit codes (0 answered / 1 negative / 2 could not answer)
nodes.norm_label: exit codes (0 answered / 1 negative / 2 could not answer)

nodes.label: Timeline (watch a repo grow, --frames)
nodes.rationale: Commit dates shifted forward by commit age so fallow scores hotspots as of each commit, not today.

nodes.label: Self-contained viewer build with CSP default-src none
nodes.rationale: Browsers won't load a module from disk, so script/styles are inlined; three.js loaders call fetch, so CSP forbids all requests.
nodes.norm_label: self-contained viewer build with csp default-src none

nodes.label: City scene (settlements, archived)
nodes.rationale: Archived so work can focus on the galaxy; kept at original paths so restoring is a move back.

nodes.label: CodeSong Ableton Live extension
nodes.rationale: Ableton Extensions SDK is confidential, so it is copied into git-ignored vendor/ and never committed.

nodes.label: Difficulty levels 1-4 (local, subsystem, across layers, relationship)
nodes.rationale: Lines changed rejected as a signal: it measures the fix, the benchmark measures the search. Grouping by level is needed to show the benefit growing with structural complexity.
nodes.norm_label: difficulty levels 1-4 (local, subsystem, across layers, relationship)

nodes.label: Tool take-up / discard bias reported not repaired
nodes.rationale: Discarding runs that never call tsyn biases towards the tool; reported as take-up and per-figure case notes (issue #112) instead of silently pooling.
nodes.norm_label: tool take-up / discard bias reported not repaired

nodes.label: Blind patch judge (correctness + similarity, 3 readings)
nodes.rationale: Judge has no tools so it grades the patch, not its own search; ties break conservatively.

nodes.label: Like-for-like result: tsyn@sonnet-5 cost +203% on level 1
nodes.norm_label: like-for-like result: tsyn@sonnet-5 cost +203% on level 1

nodes.label: Composer (harmony, melody, rhythm, arrangement)
nodes.rationale: The composer stays Ableton-independent.

nodes.label: MusicalGenome
nodes.rationale: An existing track as a reusable model the repository modifies or controls.

nodes.label: Ableton renderer / integration
nodes.rationale: Ableton Live is the primary production environment via official APIs.

nodes.label: Software architecture becomes musical structure
nodes.rationale: Core artistic premise of CodeSong.

nodes.label: PRD v1 (frozen original)
nodes.rationale: Kept unedited rather than deleted because ADRs 0001-0011 cite it by section number; a citation records what a decision was taken against. Where it and the ADRs disagree, the ADRs win.

nodes.label: Local first principle
nodes.rationale: Source code is never uploaded; the index lives in the working tree.

nodes.label: Deterministic principle
nodes.rationale: Byte-identical output forbids relevance ranking anywhere in the core.

nodes.label: fallow boundary
nodes.rationale: Two tools answering one question is worse than either alone; Typesynesthesia implements no analysis fallow ships.

nodes.label: Path of one command (parse, session, answer, render, exit)
nodes.norm_label: path of one command (parse, session, answer, render, exit)

nodes.label: tsyn commands (analyse, symbol, callers, trace, impact, docs, doctor, report-bug)
nodes.norm_label: tsyn commands (analyse, symbol, callers, trace, impact, docs, doctor, report-bug)

nodes.label: ADR 0001: Preconditions lower fidelity; honesty is evidence
nodes.norm_label: adr 0001: preconditions lower fidelity; honesty is evidence

nodes.label: Fidelity
nodes.rationale: An unmet precondition lowers a file's fidelity rather than aborting analysis; one unprepared package must not downgrade a whole monorepo.

nodes.label: Blind spot
nodes.rationale: Uncertainty is reported as named files that could have changed this answer, not a repo-wide confidence score, because a percentage cannot tell the caller whether this answer is affected.

nodes.label: Never execute repository code
nodes.rationale: postinstall is arbitrary code from a possibly unfamiliar repo; the caller (agent or human) can already run commands with consent.

nodes.label: ADR 0002: Symbol identity is a normalised SCIP string
nodes.norm_label: adr 0002: symbol identity is a normalised scip string

nodes.label: SymbolId (normalised SCIP symbol string)
nodes.rationale: Identity is deterministic and snapshot-scoped; rename/move-stable ids were rejected so cross-commit recognition is a separate inferred layer.

nodes.label: Five node types (Package, Project, File, Symbol, Document)
nodes.rationale: Repository became the index header and Relationship/Change were dropped: a node with no edges is a header wearing a costume.
nodes.norm_label: five node types (package, project, file, symbol, document)

nodes.label: Provenance and derivation per edge instance
nodes.rationale: The same edge kind can be deterministic at one call site and inferred at the next.
nodes.norm_label: provenance and derivation per edge instance

nodes.label: SCIP
nodes.rationale: Used as the identity string format, not as the storage substrate.

nodes.label: ADR 0003: Classification is a label layer on two axes
nodes.norm_label: adr 0003: classification is a label layer on two axes

nodes.label: Label (classification fact)
nodes.rationale: Not a File attribute and not a sixth node type; recomputed every run (~0.9 s) instead of incremental invalidation.

nodes.label: ADR 0004: One SQLite index per working tree that heals itself
nodes.norm_label: adr 0004: one sqlite index per working tree that heals itself

nodes.label: SQLite index at .tsyn/index.db
nodes.rationale: SQLite via node:sqlite chosen on measurement over JSON blobs, NDJSON, shards and graph stores; gitignored, one snapshot, discarded not migrated on schema change.

nodes.label: Stat signature drift detection
nodes.rationale: Git is not the drift detector; the tree is compared against recorded stat signatures before every answer.

nodes.label: Re-analyse then answer (self-healing index)
nodes.rationale: Silence is the one behaviour ruled out; a stale answer names drifted files as blind spots.

nodes.label: One index file is one snapshot
nodes.norm_label: one index file is one snapshot

nodes.label: ADR 0005: Documents make claims; every verdict has one source
nodes.norm_label: adr 0005: documents make claims; every verdict has one source

nodes.label: Claim
nodes.rationale: Pointers cannot decide staleness (59-77% false alarms measured), so documents make checkable claims from a closed predicate set; the agent writes claims, Typesynesthesia validates them.

nodes.label: Four verdicts (verified, contradicted, potentially stale, unable to verify)
nodes.rationale: Each verdict has exactly one producer; nothing blends them.
nodes.norm_label: four verdicts (verified, contradicted, potentially stale, unable to verify)

nodes.label: ADR 0006: One operation, three bindings, one envelope
nodes.norm_label: adr 0006: one operation, three bindings, one envelope

nodes.label: Operation (unit of the product)
nodes.rationale: CLI, --json and MCP are three one-to-one bindings; composition happens inside an operation, never above.

nodes.label: Four renderer rules
nodes.rationale: Total order, byte-identical reproducibility, explicit --json, human renderer as pure function of the envelope.

nodes.label: Three channels of honesty (blind spot, truncation, scope)
nodes.rationale: Must never blur into a score.
nodes.norm_label: three channels of honesty (blind spot, truncation, scope)

nodes.label: Exit codes (0 answered, 1 negative finding, 2 could not answer)
nodes.norm_label: exit codes (0 answered, 1 negative finding, 2 could not answer)

nodes.label: evidence operation
nodes.rationale: Replaces misnamed explain; docs generate deleted (later reversed by ADR 0013).

nodes.label: ADR 0007: Continuity is two inferred matchers
nodes.norm_label: adr 0007: continuity is two inferred matchers

nodes.label: Subject matching (git probe first)
nodes.rationale: From a dead path git names the destination in <200 ms; needs no second index.

nodes.label: Ranked candidate list
nodes.rationale: No confidence score and no 'deleted' verdict; an empty list means no candidate found.

nodes.label: ADR 0008: Baselines recorded by normal use, never leave the machine
nodes.norm_label: adr 0008: baselines recorded by normal use, never leave the machine

nodes.label: Baseline (.tsyn/base/<commit>.db)
nodes.rationale: Rebuilding is impossible at usable fidelity (no node_modules in a worktree), so baselines are captured during clean-tree analyse, capped at three, never transferred.

nodes.label: Missing baseline is a blind spot
nodes.norm_label: missing baseline is a blind spot

nodes.label: getSemanticDiagnostics removed from preflight
nodes.rationale: It cost 36.4 s on cal.com, was never one of ADR 0001's four signals, and cannot distinguish a prepared repo from an unprepared one.

nodes.label: Unresolved specifiers as per-site facts
nodes.rationale: Every unresolved specifier is stored; signal 4 is not a ratio with a threshold.

nodes.label: ADR 0010: tsyn.jsonc holds facts Typesynesthesia cannot determine
nodes.norm_label: adr 0010: tsyn.jsonc holds facts typesynesthesia cannot determine

nodes.label: tsyn.jsonc configuration file
nodes.rationale: Rule for entry: a key enters only when Typesynesthesia cannot determine the fact; holds facts, never preferences; file is optional.

nodes.label: ADR 0011: report-bug payload, safe shape by default
nodes.norm_label: adr 0011: report-bug payload, safe shape by default

nodes.label: Report (tsyn-report.json)
nodes.rationale: The only output meant to travel; facts about Typesynesthesia or the machine are default, facts naming user code are behind --with-repository; no hashing, no transmission.

nodes.label: No network (build-time check)
nodes.rationale: Typesynesthesia never transmits the report, and that is enforced at build time.

nodes.label: ADR 0012: Audience and the fallow boundary
nodes.norm_label: adr 0012: audience and the fallow boundary

nodes.label: Rule: implement no analysis fallow already ships
nodes.rationale: Two tools reporting on one repository will disagree and a developer cannot decide which is right; the accuracy gain of a typed dead-code pass is unmeasured, the confusion is certain.
nodes.norm_label: rule: implement no analysis fallow already ships

nodes.label: review and plan operations deleted
nodes.rationale: review splits into fallow's hygiene checks plus impact and docs affected rendered together; plan is a ranking, which is a judgement the determinism rule forbids.

nodes.label: impact is the only composed operation
nodes.rationale: It alone needs the continuity matcher, a baseline and the trace reachability walk at once; no combination of other operations produces it.
nodes.norm_label: impact is the only composed operation

nodes.label: Affected tests as impact --label role=test
nodes.rationale: A dedicated affected-tests operation would be a second traversal to keep in step with impact forever.

nodes.label: Candidate claim marker <!-- tsyn?: -->
nodes.rationale: docs check discovers documents by scanning for <!-- tsyn:, which the ?-marker does not match, so drafted claims never count towards coverage until a person deletes the ?.

nodes.label: docs draft overwrite refusal (no --force)
nodes.rationale: Writing to a derived path by default keeps the write inside the refusal; a stdout default would push users to an unguarded shell redirect.

nodes.label: docs draft operation
nodes.rationale: Writes facts, markers and headings beside the code (docs/ sibling folder), never prose and never a timestamp, so output is byte-identical per commit.

nodes.label: Per-subject keyed result (request.subjects)
nodes.rationale: The envelope shape must not depend on argument count; budget, truncation, blind spots and excluded counts are per subject because pooling would make answers depend on argument order.

nodes.label: ADR 0015: A trim flag that shrinks the envelope, not the truth
nodes.norm_label: adr 0015: a trim flag that shrinks the envelope, not the truth

nodes.label: Trim rule: reconstructible or redundant, never a fact
nodes.rationale: Only drop fields a caller can derive or that carry no information in their current state; never blind spots, budget, excluded, resolved or error.
nodes.norm_label: trim rule: reconstructible or redundant, never a fact

nodes.label: Three honesty channels: blind spot, truncation, scope exclusion
nodes.norm_label: three honesty channels: blind spot, truncation, scope exclusion

nodes.label: ADR 0016: The inward walk needs a subject; trace gains a direction
nodes.norm_label: adr 0016: the inward walk needs a subject; trace gains a direction

nodes.label: trace --inbound direction flag
nodes.rationale: Reads the edge table from the other side (readCallerSteps vs readCalleeSteps) with the same cycle handling and depth cut, so it adds no second traversal; a reaches operation would.

nodes.label: Inbound walk reports blind spots across walked subtree
nodes.rationale: Missing edges under-report who depends on a symbol right before a change; an empty inbound trace means no caller was resolved, not that the symbol is unreferenced.
nodes.norm_label: inbound walk reports blind spots across walked subtree

nodes.label: ADR 0017: A claim can be asked without being written down
nodes.norm_label: adr 0017: a claim can be asked without being written down

nodes.label: verify '<claim>' operation
nodes.rationale: The proposition comes from the caller, so it is not review returning; it writes nothing, so it cannot inflate claim coverage. Reaches only verified, contradicted and unable to verify, never potentially stale.

nodes.label: ADR 0018: The package boundary is a filter on an edge
nodes.norm_label: adr 0018: the package boundary is a filter on an edge

nodes.label: --outside package|project scope boundary filter
nodes.rationale: Boundary is a relation between two nodes, not a label property, so Scope gains a boundary member with its own excluded count; a surface <package> operation was refused as fallow dead-code in disguise.

nodes.label: Keep the two jobs apart
nodes.rationale: Use the index for deterministic structure instead of rediscovering it via repeated search; it does not replace reading source.

nodes.label: Single-context domain docs
nodes.rationale: One CONTEXT.md and one docs/adr/ at the root; a CONTEXT-MAP.md would signal a multi-context repo whose per-context docs follow the pnpm workspace roots. Absent files are proceeded past silently, because the producer skill creates them lazily.

nodes.label: Use the glossary's vocabulary
nodes.rationale: A concept missing from the glossary is a signal: either the agent is inventing language the project does not use, or there is a real gap. ADR conflicts must be surfaced explicitly rather than silently overridden.

nodes.label: Canonical triage labels
nodes.rationale: Five roles — needs-triage, needs-info, ready-for-agent, ready-for-human, wontfix. GitHub's default `question` and `help wanted` look adjacent but are not interchangeable.

nodes.label: Spike: cross-file call graph, two backends, measured
nodes.norm_label: spike: cross-file call graph, two backends, measured

nodes.label: Sweep call sites, do not query symbols
nodes.rationale: Per-symbol who-calls-X is unbatchable (projected 122 s per cal.com project); sweeping call sites and batch-resolving callees gives a strict superset in 4.1 s, 22.9 s whole-repo.
nodes.norm_label: sweep call sites, do not query symbols

nodes.label: TypeScript 7.0.2 typescript/unstable/sync backend
nodes.rationale: getSignatureUsage reproduces TS6 call hierarchy edge for edge (150/150); TS6 exhausts an 8 GB heap on cal.com while TS7 peaks at 2.4 GB. Accepted risk: explicitly unstable API.

nodes.label: Capability matrix: which tool produces which required fact
nodes.norm_label: capability matrix: which tool produces which required fact

nodes.label: PRD §24: no custom static-analysis engine (analysis, not aggregation)
nodes.rationale: Every required fact has an existing producer; the tool's irreducible job is the driver, normalised model and store. Oxc embedding typescript-go is cited as external validation.
nodes.norm_label: prd §24: no custom static-analysis engine (analysis, not aggregation)

nodes.label: Pipeline: type layer + oxc syntactic sweep + manifests + git -> adapter -> model -> store
nodes.norm_label: pipeline: type layer + oxc syntactic sweep + manifests + git -> adapter -> model -> store

nodes.label: Licence and redistribution audit of analysis dependencies
nodes.norm_label: licence and redistribution audit of analysis dependencies

nodes.label: Graphify licence AMBIGUOUS (MIT 0.8.37 -> Apache-2.0 0.9.53)
nodes.rationale: Needs a human call because of licence volatility, not the current licence.

nodes.label: Reconciling edge count: spike 81,888 vs skeleton 26,091
nodes.norm_label: reconciling edge count: spike 81,888 vs skeleton 26,091

nodes.label: Spike counted each call site once per globbing project
nodes.norm_label: spike counted each call site once per globbing project

nodes.label: 6,746 symbols collapse on their id (issue #34)
nodes.rationale: Anonymous callbacks add no qualified-name segment, so locals in sibling it() blocks share an id; bounded to non-durable locals but callers over-reports.

nodes.label: Incremental re-analysis with existing TypeScript tooling
nodes.norm_label: incremental re-analysis with existing typescript tooling

nodes.label: Signature-gated incremental wave (export-shape hash)
nodes.rationale: updateSnapshot then re-extract only the changed file, propagating to importers only when its typeToString shape hash changed: 1-3 files in 3-5 ms vs 535 ms cold.

nodes.label: Prior art: how code-intelligence indexes model and persist symbols
nodes.norm_label: prior art: how code-intelligence indexes model and persist symbols

nodes.label: SymbolId as SCIP symbol string (not SCIP storage)
nodes.rationale: SCIP is a transmission format, not a storage format; adopt its naming grammar with workspace versions normalised and locals path-prefixed and non-durable.
nodes.norm_label: symbolid as scip symbol string (not scip storage)

nodes.label: Cross-commit symbol identity is an inferred matching layer
nodes.rationale: No system (SCIP, LSIF, Kythe, Glean, CodeQL) survives rename/move; identity across commits needs comparing two snapshots heuristically, so it must not live in a primary key.
nodes.norm_label: cross-commit symbol identity is an inferred matching layer

nodes.label: Documentation that can be checked (claim predicates, four verdicts)
nodes.norm_label: documentation that can be checked (claim predicates, four verdicts)

nodes.label: Fixture: Markdown carrying no claim
nodes.rationale: The scan reads it and it is not a document, demonstrating that writing a claim is how a file opts in.

nodes.label: Test fixture document: Payments (claims and coverage)
nodes.norm_label: test fixture document: payments (claims and coverage)

nodes.label: Example Apps Consume Packages By Link
nodes.norm_label: example apps consume packages by link
